transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?
My eating has gotten all mixed up. Some days I forget lunch entirely, and other days I just stand at the counter eating crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
How has your mood been feeling recently?
Most mornings I wake up feeling pretty low and heavy. It’s like all the color has gone out of the day before I’ve even gotten dressed.
How long have you been feeling this low and heavy?
It’s been going on for about a year and two months now—the low, colorless feeling.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, hyper, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
I’m not really sure what you mean. I haven’t noticed times where I felt especially energized or on top of things.
Before this past year and two months, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt this low or depressed?
I don’t think so. At least, I can’t remember having a stretch like this before.
During this past year and two months, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where you felt like your normal self?

No, I don’t think there was a stretch that long where I felt back to normal. Looking back, the sadness and not being interested in things were there most of the time, even when I wasn’t as worried about the records.
How has your sleep been over this past year and two months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep over that time.
How have your energy levels been over this past year and two months?
My energy feels low. My body’s been slowed down—it can take me twice as long just to cross the room or button my sweater. But then sometimes I’ll pace around the house holding the same papers.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt recently?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed feelings like that recently.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing, or making everyday decisions?
Yes. Even simple decisions can make my mind feel foggy. I’ll sit there wondering whether to call the pharmacy or open the mail first, and then I end up doing neither.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you would be better off not waking up?
I don’t have any plan to hurt myself. But... I do sometimes think that if I didn’t wake up one morning, it might be a relief to everyone.
